description: Classify a list of repo-relative changed paths using the exact per-file static-gate predicate owned by quality_gates/code_quality_check.py. Returns the paths covered by the regular per-file quality surface and paths outside it, with manual_static_analysis_needed=true whenever an out-of-scope path needs a Git-Controller ruff, pyright, or radon supplement. This is a read-only classification and never runs or changes Git.
embedding_description: Check whether changed paths are covered by the platform code_quality_check per-file static analysis surface. Identify out-of-scope files such as .claude hooks or other unlisted paths before a landing relies only on the whole-tree quality gate, so Git-Controller knows when to run manual ruff, pyright, and radon checks.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Object with normalized paths, in_scope, out_of_scope, manual_static_analysis_needed, and scope_source.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with manual_static_analysis_needed. If true, list every out_of_scope path and state that a manual static-analysis supplement is needed before relying on whole-tree evidence.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Classification is advisory evidence only; it does not run gates or authorize a landing.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Normalizing repo-relative path strings and reading the code-quality scope predicate.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValueError means the list was empty or a supplied path was absolute, empty, or attempted traversal. This does not indicate a Git or quality-gate failure.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Pass one or more non-empty repo-relative changed paths exactly as Git tracks them, then use the returned out_of_scope list to choose any supplemental checks.
